title_original: Artists and theme announced for 2027 Bukhara Biennial
excerpt_original: The 2027 Bukhara Biennial will be titled ‘The Long Welcome’

blocks.caption: Poi-Kalon Complex, Bukhara. Courtesy the Uzbekistan Art and Culture Development Foundation, Tashkent

blocks.text: The 2027 Bukhara Biennial, led by artistic director Kulapat Yantrasast , will be titled The Long Welcome .

The exhibition theme draws on the history of Bukhara as a meeting point along the Silk Road and considers hospitality as a reciprocal act. Building on the model of the biennial’s inaugural exhibition in 2025, which paired artists with local artisans, the 2027 edition will also pair artists with local ecologists, economists, historians, teachers, musicians and children.

All of the exhibited works will be new commissions made in Uzbekistan. The initial list of participating artists is as follows: Anish Kapoor, Koo Jeong A , Sevara Haydarova Donazzan, Susan Philipsz , Nigina Mirzadzhanova, Precious Okoyomon, Ugo Rondinone, Vivian Suter , Joseph Arzoumanov, Oscar Tuazon, Maksim Vardanyan and Daima Rakhmanbekova, Huma Bhabha , Bethan Laura Wood.
